targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.node.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.node.memory.working_set' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Node pressure (1 = under pressure)
panels.description: Needs node_conditions_to_report in the k8s_cluster receiver (set in cluster-values.yaml).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'], ' ', MetricName) AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('k8s.node.condition_memory_pressure', 'k8s.node.condition_disk_pressure', 'k8s.node.condition_pid_pressure') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, ns AS series, sum(v) AS value FROM ( SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS ns, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) GROUP BY time, ns, pod) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, ns AS series, sum(v) AS value FROM ( SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS ns, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) GROUP BY time, ns, pod) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN ($pod) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN ($pod) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory vs limit (per pod, latest)
panels.description: Pods without a memory limit have no row (no limit to compare with): itself a finding.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.pod AS pod, round(m.mem / 1048576, 1) AS memory_mib, round(l.lim / 1048576, 1) AS limit_mib, round(100 * m.mem / l.lim, 1) AS percent_of_limit FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS mem FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) GROUP BY pod) AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, sum(Value) AS lim FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.container.memory_limit' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) GROUP BY pod) AS l ON m.pod = l.pod WHERE l.lim > 0 ORDER BY percent_of_limit DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Container restarts (increase in range)
panels.description: If this stays empty but you know a pod restarted, the metric may be in otel_metrics_sum: check names.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, max(Value) - min(Value) AS restarts FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) GROUP BY namespace, pod, container HAVING restarts > 0 ORDER BY restarts DESC

panels.title: Pods not Running (latest phase)
panels.description: Phase codes: 1 Pending, 2 Running, 3 Succeeded, 4 Failed, 5 Unknown (check the receiver docs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS phase FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.phase' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) GROUP BY namespace, pod HAVING phase != 2 ORDER BY phase DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'k8s.deployment.', '')) AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.desired', 'k8s.deployment.available') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: HPA replicas
panels.description: Metric names depend on the receiver version: list them first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.hpa.name'], ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'k8s.hpa.', '')) AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('k8s.hpa.current_replicas', 'k8s.hpa.desired_replicas') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'] IN ($cluster) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
